text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Found the book! It's way up high, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Looks like someone else is using the 
stepladder, though... Alright, for now...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... Thank goodness... I 
managed to catch—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I'm so sorry, I didn't notice you! 
It's because I was using the stepladder... 
Haa... Seriously, what is wrong with 
me...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
! N-No! It's my fault for not saying 
something sooner...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although Nishino Flower managed to get the 
book she was looking for, she ended up 
feeling bad for making the other person go 
out of their way...
